Title: Implement square class
Description:
'- The class must represent a single board cell.
- Each square must store its row and column position.
- A square can contain elements such as walls, boxes, goals or the player.
- The class must allow checking whether the square is occupied.
Author: BENÍTEZ MAIDANA, LUCAS DANIEL

Title: Total Game Score Class
Description:
Class for the total game score that records and sums all scores from previous levels.

Persistent Registry: It maintains a record of all completed levels.

Summation: It calculates the cumulative total of all moves/points.

Final Display: The total is displayed to the player upon completing the game.
Author: HE, JIAXU

Title: Implement Wall Class
Description:
'- A wall must be placed inside a square of the board.
- The player and boxes cannot move through walls.
- Consecutive walls should be visually connected as a single structure in the graphical interface.
Author: BENÍTEZ MAIDANA, LUCAS DANIEL

Title: Implementation of Goal

Author: COSOR STRIMBEANU, DENIS ANDREI

Title: Implement "LevelFileReader" class
Description:
Program a class that reads the different levels from 1 to n from a text file, generating each level in the process. If there are no more levels, the game ends.

- You must check if each level in the text file is valid:

- The first line is the level name.

- The next line contains two numbers, representing the number of rows and columns, respectively.

The following n lines (equal to the number of rows) contain the level, which is composed of:

+: Wall

*: Goal

#: Box

W : Main Character

The following conditions must be met:

- There must be at least one box and one goal.

- There must be only one character.

- There must be the same number of goals as boxes.

- If the above conditions are not met, display a custom error message.
Author: CUÑARRO ALFONSÍN, MATEO

Title: Implementation of LevelRecorder
Description: Implementation of the class LevelRecorder that records the moves made by the player in the current level and allows the loading of an old save.

Title: Implement Level Interface Information Panel

Title: Main Menu Interface

Title: Implement Save Slot Manager
Description:
Develop a class responsible for saving the current game state and managing multiple save slots.
- The class must save the current game state.
- The game state must include the current level, player position, box positions, level score and total score.
Author: BENÍTEZ MAIDANA, LUCAS DANIEL

Title: BoxManager Class
Description:
Class used to handle box movement logic.

Movement Validation: Checks if a move is valid based on the next position's status (empty or goal).

Collision Detection: Ensures boxes do not overlap with walls or other boxes.

Coordinate Update: Updates the box's position within the grid after a successful move.
Author: HE, JIAXU
